hooks.command: command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook session-start || true
command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook permission-request || true
command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook user-prompt-submit || true
command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook post-tool-use || true
command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook post-tool-use-failure || true
command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook notification || true
command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook stop || true
command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook pre-compact || true
command -v agentdock-runner >/dev/null 2>&1 && agentdock-runner hook session-end || true
